description: ImportError: cannot import name 'UserModel' from partially initialized module 'models'
expectedSolution: Break circular import using TYPE_CHECKING guard, lazy imports, or restructure module dependencies

description: RuntimeError: This event loop is already running when using asyncio in Jupyter notebook
expectedSolution: Use nest_asyncio.apply() or restructure to avoid nested event loops. In Jupyter, use await directly

description: PydanticUserError: Field required after migrating from Pydantic v1 to v2
expectedSolution: Update Field definitions to v2 syntax. Use model_config = ConfigDict() instead of class Config

description: Django ORM making hundreds of SQL queries for a single page load. N+1 query problem
expectedSolution: Use select_related for ForeignKey and prefetch_related for ManyToMany to eager-load related objects

description: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'requests' despite being installed via pip
expectedSolution: Ensure the correct virtualenv is activated. Check which python and which pip point to the right environment

description: SettingWithCopyWarning: A value is trying to be set on a copy of a slice from a DataFrame
expectedSolution: Use .loc[] for assignment instead of chained indexing: df.loc[condition, 'column'] = value

description: RuntimeError: Working outside of application context when accessing current_app in Flask
expectedSolution: Use with app.app_context(): block or ensure the function is called within a request or CLI context

description: PicklingError: Can't pickle local object when using multiprocessing with lambda functions
expectedSolution: Move lambda to a named top-level function. Or use dill/pathos for better pickling support

description: Alembic migration fails: Target database is not up to date. Multiple heads detected
expectedSolution: Run alembic merge heads to create a merge migration, or alembic stamp head to reset migration state

description: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |: 'type' and 'NoneType' in Python 3.9 type hints
expectedSolution: Use from __future__ import annotations for Python 3.9, or use Optional[str] instead of str | None

description: kombu.exceptions.EncodeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable in Celery task
expectedSolution: Convert datetime to string with .isoformat() before passing to Celery task, or use pickle serializer

description: FastAPI Depends() not injecting database session correctly, getting None in route handler
expectedSolution: Use yield-based dependency with proper async session lifecycle: async def get_db(): yield session

description: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded when processing deeply nested JSON structure
expectedSolution: Convert recursive algorithm to iterative using an explicit stack (collections.deque)

description: Gunicorn worker timeout: Worker killed due to long-running request exceeding 30s timeout
expectedSolution: Move long tasks to background worker (Celery). Or increase timeout and use gevent/uvicorn workers

description: Poetry lock file conflict after merging branches, SolverProblemError on install
expectedSolution: Delete poetry.lock and run poetry lock to regenerate. Resolve version conflicts in pyproject.toml first
